title: Is Flood Insurance Required for a Mortgage? SC Buyer Guide
description: When flood insurance is required for a mortgage, what Zone X and AE mean, how much coverage your lender needs, and how the premium affects what you can afford.
focusKeyphrase: is flood insurance required for a mortgage
h1: Is Flood Insurance Required for a Mortgage?
dek: Buying near the water in South Carolina? Here's when your lender will require it, and how much.

faq.q: Is flood insurance required for a mortgage in Zone AE?
faq.a: Yes. Zone AE is a high-risk flood zone, so lenders require flood insurance on the home for conventional, FHA, VA and bank loans.

faq.q: Is flood insurance required to be escrowed?
faq.a: Usually. Federally regulated lenders must collect flood premiums through escrow, with a few exceptions, so the premium is paid along with your monthly mortgage payment.

faq.q: Is there a waiting period for flood insurance when buying a house?
faq.a: No. A federal flood policy bought with a new loan takes effect at closing, as long as you apply and pay by then. Without a loan, a new policy normally starts 30 days after you apply and pay.

sources.name: 12 CFR Part 339, Loans in Areas Having Special Flood Hazards
